headline: GOLD HOLDS $3,640 AHEAD OF PCE — Thanksgiving Eve Inflation Print Is Make-or-Break for Mining Recovery
snippet: Gold consolidated near $3,638 per ounce on Tuesday as markets entered Thanksgiving week with thin liquidity and one critical data point looming: Wednesday's PCE inflation report. Silver traded at $43.38/oz after Monday's 3.6% rebound. Analysts warn that a hot PCE print could revive near-certain pricing for a December 50bps Fed hike and erase much of Monday's recovery in a single session, while thin holiday-week volumes would amplify any move in either direction.

headline: COPPER ROARS BACK FROM BEAR MARKET — LME Rises to $12,287/t as Huang Returns to Nvidia; Panama Talks Add Supply Catalyst
snippet: LME copper climbed to $12,287 per tonne on November 24, bouncing from a confirmed bear market after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO — restoring confidence in the AI datacenter demand thesis that drove copper to September records. Mining.com also reported that Panama and First Quantum Minerals have reopened talks on a possible restart of the Cobre Panama mine, the world's third-largest copper operation, adding a supply-side catalyst to the demand-side reversal.

headline: TRISTAR GOLD BLIND DISCOVERY: 340M AT 1.09 G/T AU — 68m at 2.09 g/t at Castelo de Sonhos; Second Drill Rig Mobilized
snippet: TriStar Gold (TSX-V: TSG) reported a blind gold discovery at its Castelo de Sonhos project in Brazil, intersecting 340 metres grading 1.09 g/t Au with a higher-grade core of 68 metres at 2.09 g/t Au. The company has mobilized a second drill rig to follow up on the concealed target, which had no surface expression. At current depressed junior mining valuations, a blind 340m intercept in a known Brazilian gold district is exactly the kind of company-making result that separates explorers from pure speculation plays.

headline: FIREFLY'S SECOND COPPER-VMS DISCOVERY IN 30 DAYS — Nash Target <10km from Ming Mine Opens District-Scale Play
snippet: FireFly Metals (TSX: FFM) announced its second major copper-rich volcanogenic massive sulphide discovery within a single month, identifying the Nash target less than 10 kilometres from the high-grade Ming Mine in Newfoundland. The company also optioned the adjacent Brass Buckle property to consolidate the emerging district corridor. Two significant new VMS targets in 30 days at a district-scale camp marks an unusually rapid exploration pace for a junior in a down market.

headline: ROCK TECH LITHIUM HITS 4.63% Li2O AT VICTORY PROJECT — 7 of 12 Grab Samples Exceed 2% in New Ontario Spodumene Find
snippet: Rock Tech Lithium (TSX-V: RCK) reported initial grab-sample results from a new spodumene pegmatite discovery at its Victory project in Northwestern Ontario, with values reaching 4.63% Li2O and seven of twelve samples exceeding 2% Li2O. The results conclude Victory's first field program, confirming the new target requires drill follow-up. With lithium equities deeply depressed and new Canadian spodumene discoveries rare, the grade profile from surface samples is an encouraging early-stage signal.

headline: EMIRATI IRH TABLES £487M BID FOR KENMARE RESOURCES — Irish Ilmenite Miner in Rare Downturn-Era M&A Move
snippet: International Resources Holding (IRH), an Emirati state-linked mining company, announced the terms of a potential acquisition of Ireland's Kenmare Resources PLC for approximately £487.1 million ($634M USD). Kenmare operates the Moma mine in Mozambique, one of the world's largest ilmenite and zircon producers — critical titanium feedstocks. The bid is conditional and not yet binding, but marks one of the few strategic mining acquisitions announced during the current downturn, suggesting sovereign buyers are treating the correction as a buying opportunity.

headline: NET BULLISH COPPER BETS FALL TO 20-MONTH LOW — CoT Washout Signals Speculative Overhang Cleared; Contrarians See Setup
snippet: CFTC Commitments of Traders data shows managed money net long positioning in copper has fallen to its lowest level in 20 months — a configuration that historically precedes mean-reversion rallies once speculative overhang is absorbed. The washout in paper copper matches physical market signals: Chinese smelters paid record import premiums of $360-500/tonne throughout the selloff, indicating the futures collapse reflected leveraged position exits rather than collapsing end-user demand.

headline: CENTRAL BANKS BUYING INTO GOLD'S COLLAPSE — Sovereign Demand Holds Firm Near 15-Month Lows as Speculators Exit
snippet: An Investing.com analysis argues that central bank gold demand has remained robust through the November selloff — a critical structural distinction from the speculative and margin-call driven selling that pushed prices from $5,405 to $3,638. Central banks, which have been net buyers for 15 consecutive quarters, hold no leverage and face no margin calls, meaning their accumulation at current prices creates a structural demand floor. WGC provisional data cited in the piece shows sovereign buying actually accelerated as prices broke below $4,000.

headline: USA RARE EARTH JUMPS 13% IN CRITICAL MINERALS REBOUND — Antimony +9%, MP Materials +6%; All Still Below Last Week
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) led a critical minerals relief rally on November 23, jumping 13%, while United States Antimony gained 9% and MP Materials rose 6% as the broader market bounce lifted the sector. Despite the recovery, every name in the group still trades below where it stood a week earlier. A William Blair analyst downgrade of USA Rare Earth over feedstock supply concerns added sector-specific pressure on top of the macro correction, raising questions about whether Monday's move was genuine accumulation or short covering.

headline: VISIBLE GOLD IN 4 OF 5 HOLES AT GRAYCLIFF SHAKESPEARE — Ontario Junior Drills 1,580m in 2026, Assays Pending
snippet: Graycliff Exploration (CSE: GRAY) reported that four of its first five 2026 drill holes at the Shakespeare Gold Project in Ontario showed visible gold, with 1,580 metres completed across the program. Assay results are delayed by laboratory backlogs affecting much of the junior mining sector this quarter. Visible gold in 80% of holes drilled is a qualitative leading indicator that warrants attention while awaiting quantitative assay confirmation.
